_comment: Flag registry (ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINTS.md §2). Every key GameState touches must be declared here; the validator fails the build on an undeclared reference. tier 'critical' means the Act One walkthrough asserts on it, and only anchor areas may set it (§7). A declaration may carry "persist": false, which keeps the flag out of GameState's save section — runtime state rather than progress. The act1.* ladder ids are PROPOSED (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1): the phase that builds each beat owns the real id and reconciles this registry with data/weirdness/curve.json.

sys.realistic_weight.description: Per-run choice made at New Game: super-realistic carry limits, which unlock extra content as enticement (EC-4a).

sys.patch_gender.description: Which gender Patch's authored pronouns resolve to, 'm' or 'f' [U2-7]. Written by the New Game screen (phase 3); unset falls back to masculine, an engineering default rather than a canon statement.

sys.village.description: Id of the starting village chosen at New Game, one of the nine in data/villages/. Read by the tell hook and the stagger beat (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §5); every other pro/con effect is deferred.

sys.player_has_control.description: True when nothing holds input — no dialogue, cutscene, battle or menu. The weirdness scheduler ticks player-time only (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2). Transient: persist false keeps it out of every save, so a save can never restore a mid-dialogue lock.

region.hold.unlocked.description: The Hold is reachable. Region locks are exactly region.<id>.unlocked and nothing else represents them.

region.turning.unlocked.description: The Turning is reachable — the one region Act One opens beyond The Hold. The unlock reason and event are [U2-2], still OPEN; until that is designed, only the critical-path walkthrough sets this.

region.measure.unlocked.description: The Measure is reachable. Locked for all of Act One; what unlocks the outer regions after the letter is [U2-2], OPEN.

region.distance.unlocked.description: The Distance is reachable. Locked for all of Act One; what unlocks the outer regions after the letter is [U2-2], OPEN.

region.quiet.unlocked.description: The Quiet is reachable. Locked for all of Act One; what unlocks the outer regions after the letter is [U2-2], OPEN.

region.flow.unlocked.description: The Flow is reachable. Locked for all of Act One; what unlocks the outer regions after the letter is [U2-2], OPEN.

region.balance.unlocked.description: The Balance is reachable. Locked for all of Act One; what unlocks the outer regions after the letter is [U2-2], OPEN.

region.hold.crossing_attempts.description: Times Patch has tried to cross into The Hold. Guard dialogue conditions on this (EC-2a).

region.total_crossing_attempts.description: Sum of crossing_attempts across all regions. Guards know this despite the world lacking the technology (EC-2a).

weird.misroutes.description: Times an exit has delivered Patch to the wrong destination. The only persisted trace of a misroute (EC-6a).

act1.nine_days_noted.description: Opening cutscene complete — Patch has registered the nine days. First rung of the weirdness ladder, +0.05 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.last_post.road_seen.description: The road home at Last Post does not go back the way it came. Ladder rung +0.10 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.mill_fixed.description: The backward mill beat is resolved. Ladder rung +0.10 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.wren.map_received.description: Wren has handed over the map. Ladder rung +0.10 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.turning.entered.description: Patch has crossed into The Turning. Ladder rung +0.15 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.abbey.arrived.description: Patch has reached the Abbey of the Hopefully Infinite Thrum. Ladder rung +0.15 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.forge_seen.description: Patch has seen The Forge. Ladder rung +0.10 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.abbey.departed.description: The return trip has begun; the ladder reaches 1.0 (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §2.1). PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the beat may rename it.

act1.letter_received.description: The summons letter is in Patch's hands — Act One's final beat. PROPOSED id: the phase that builds the letter beat may rename it. What this does to the outer region locks is [U2-2], still OPEN; the walkthrough's post-letter assertion stays pending until that is designed.
